paper_title: Searching for Time-Dependent Axion Dark Matter Signals in Pulsars
notes: Time-domain axion-photon conversion search in pulsar PSR J2144-3933 magnetosphere using MeerKAT. Fiducial limit g_agamma < 5.5e-11 GeV^-1 over 3.9-4.7 ueV assuming D=0.165 kpc (parallax). Alternative D=0.29 kpc gives 9.6e-11. Limit scales linearly with distance. Encoded as flat horizontal line over stated mass range.
